breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in its preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)') which conflicted with the specific instruction for the task in section 7 ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble and used the specific instruction from section 7, stating 'dx=1/Nx'. This aligns with the ground truth, which resolved the conflict by removing the incorrect instruction from the preamble.
